title: scripts/demo/seed-demo-server.mjs writes the tree_index root from buildTree() with no tenantId field, so the API's treeIndexRootFilter (which now requires a real tenantId term) cannot find the demo root
area: scripts/demo/seed-demo-server.mjs:37-38 (deleteMany/insertOne keyed by node_id only); indexSession stamps tenantId at write time, this script does not
evidence: buildTree's fresh root never carries tenantId (apps/api/src/indexing/session.ts comment at the rootDoc stamp); treeIndexRootFilter returns {node_id, level, tenantId}. Not an isolation leak (the demo tenant is the literal "toc"); a functional gap in a demo script. Not run (needs a live database).
fix_direction: insert {...root, tenantId} (and filter the deleteMany by tenantId too); file-don't-fix (low, demo script).

title: treeIndexRootFilter (packages/index/src/tree/build.ts:49) still builds a tenant filter without validating its argument; every current caller (apps/api store.ts, scripts/backfill.mjs) is guarded or accessor-first, a future caller would not be
area: packages/index/src/tree/build.ts:49 (packages/index does not depend on @lkb/db, so it cannot import assertValidTenantId without a new package dependency)
evidence: packages/index/package.json dependencies: @lkb/core, @lkb/ai only. The guard was therefore placed at the callers (store.ts tree load and graph load, with tests); the single source of the filter is unguarded.
fix_direction: move assertValidTenantId (or a pure isValidTenantId) into @lkb/core and have both @lkb/db and @lkb/index import it. Needs an architecture decision (shared package change); file-don't-fix.

title: Raw tenant filters fed only by a literal, env string or CLI string were deliberately left without their own validator: watch-reingest.mjs (TENANT literal "toc" from watch-config.mjs:17), seed-demo-server.mjs (literal "toc"), upload/queue.mjs scope() (UPLOAD_TENANT_ID, trimmed, <=200, dedicated upload_queue_* database)
evidence: A string can never be a Mongo operator, so these values cannot widen a filter; the residual risk is a string with control characters matching only itself. None is reachable from an HTTP caller. scripts/ is at its 32-entry budget and upload/*.mjs run without tsx, so importing the TS validator there needs a loader change.
fix_direction: when the shared validator moves to @lkb/core (ISS-TENANTFLT-002) import it in these three scripts; file-don't-fix.
